posts.title: Requirements Engineering is a profession
posts.excerpt: Thank you, Patrick! I have seen this so many times throughout my professional career. Requirements Engineering is a profession, and it requires a specific skill set learned through education and practical experience. Invest in people, education and clear requirements.

posts.title: AI verändert die Geschwindigkeit der Softwareentwicklung
posts.excerpt: AI verändert derzeit vor allem die Geschwindigkeit der Softwareentwicklung. Die eigentliche Herausforderung bleibt jedoch, Software so zu entwickeln, dass sie auch in fünf oder zehn Jahren noch wartbar, nachvollziehbar und erweiterbar ist.

posts.title: Congratulations on an accepted SpaceCHI paper
posts.excerpt: Congratulations, Matti, on your accepted paper! This is fantastic work and very well deserved. Beyond intuitive AR/XR data visualization, the underlying architecture makes AI access more trustworthy and elegantly prevents hallucinated information.

posts.title: Physical AI & Humanoide Robotik in der ARENA2036
posts.excerpt: Ich freue mich sehr, Teil der ARENA2036 und des Projekts Physical AI & Humanoide Robotik zu sein. Im Workstream UX, Interfaces and Human Computer Interaction erforschen wir, wie Menschen künftig intuitiv, sicher und vertrauensvoll mit Physical AI interagieren können.

posts.title: Human-AI interaction for autonomous mobility
posts.excerpt: It was a pleasure meeting at HCII 2026 and discussing research with strong connections to our CARpulse project, particularly future human-AI interaction for autonomous mobility. I hope we can continue the conversation and collaborate in the future.

posts.title: Session Chair at the IEEE Intelligent Vehicles Symposium 2026
posts.excerpt: It was a pleasure to serve as Session Chair for the Cooperation & Communication session at IEEE IV 2026 in Detroit. The session explored how future intelligent vehicles can cooperate, communicate and interact more effectively with users and environments.

posts.title: Human-centered LLM applications at KES 2026
posts.excerpt: I am looking forward to KES 2026 in Dublin. Our accepted paper explores how human-centered design principles can guide LLM-based applications and shares lessons from an AI-supported app review summarization tool.

posts.title: Innovation ecosystem ARENA2036
posts.excerpt: Vielen Dank für die tolle Veranstaltung! Die ARENA2036 ist für mich eines der spannendsten Innovationsökosysteme Deutschlands. Besonders beeindruckend ist die offene Zusammenarbeit zwischen Industrie, Wissenschaft und Start-ups.
